subject: PO issuance & itemized spend cap splits for SaaSify onboarding
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@saasify.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO issuance & spend cap / line-item splits for SaaSify onboarding

Hi Elena —

Thanks for completing the vendor onboarding intake. We are ready to issue the initial PO for the first quarter of usage, but procurement needs a confirmed breakdown of line items and the final spend cap so we can attach the correct PO number. A few specifics we need to lock down before PO issuance: 

- Final list of billable SKUs (monthly license, overage tokens, premium support) and per-unit rates.
- Any one-time onboarding/setup fee (amount and GL code if available).
- Preferred PO billing contact and billing email (we will copy AP).
- Whether SaaSify requires multiple PO numbers per region or one global PO.

Monica, Naomi — I’ve looped you in for procurement visibility. We’d prefer to keep the spend cap at the initially requested $75k for Q3 but are open to splitting it into buckets (Subscription / Overage / Support) if that makes accounting easier for SaaSify.

Elena, can you confirm the SKU breakdown and confirm whether your team needs separate PO numbers for support vs licensing? If you can provide the filled onboarding form + a draft invoice, procurement (Monica) can issue PO_78932 and share the PDF back.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Form_SaaSify.pdf (fillable)
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@saasify.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: SaaSify Finance <ap@saasify.io>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 13:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: PO issuance & spend cap / line-item splits for SaaSify onboarding

Hi Karthik —

Thanks — attaching the completed onboarding form and a draft pro forma invoice. Quick answers inline: 

- SKUs: MONTHLY_LICENSE (USD 12,500/mo), TOKEN_OVERAGE (USD 0.015/token), PREMIUM_SUPPORT (USD 3,000/mo).
- One-time onboarding: USD 6,500 (GL: 5402).
- Billing contact: AP Team <ap@saasify.io> (please cc).
- We can accept a single PO covering all items; if Redwood prefers split POs for Subscription vs Support we can map them to separate GLs.

We would prefer a single PO for the quarter and to have the onboarding fee listed as a separate line item. If Redwood needs it split, we can accept PO numbers on the invoice for each bucket.

Elena
Vendor Operations
SaaSify Inc.

Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form_SaaSify.pdf, Draft_Invoice_SaaSify.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@saasify.io>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO issuance & spend cap / line-item splits for SaaSify onboarding

Thanks, Elena — the pro forma helps. A couple of procurement notes before I generate the PO: 

- We will issue a single PO number (PO_78932) for Q3 but need the invoice to show three explicit line items mapped to our GL buckets: Subscription, Overage (estimate cap), and Support (on-demand).
- For the token overage line, procurement requires an estimated monthly cap to be listed on the PO so we can set a spend cap. Please provide an estimated monthly token burn for Redwood (or a capped monthly amount). For now we will set a provisional monthly cap of $25,000 under Overage unless you propose otherwise.
- Onboarding fee will be listed as one-time charge line; please confirm GL code (you provided 5402 which is fine).
- Please confirm billing email for invoice submission (ap@saasify.io is OK) and whether SaaSify needs any specific PO reference text in the invoice PDF.

If SaaSify agrees to the provisional $25k/month overage cap, I’ll issue PO_78932 today and share the signed PDF. If you prefer per-bucket POs, we can instead issue two PO numbers (one for Subscription+Onboarding, one for Support+Overage) but that will require additional accounting steps on our side.

Monica
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: LineItem_Allocation_v2.xlsx (procurement template)
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@saasify.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: SaaSify Finance <ap@saasify.io>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: PO issuance & spend cap / line-item splits for SaaSify onboarding

Monica —

Confirmed. We accept the provisional $25,000/month overage cap. We will include three line items on the invoice and reference PO_78932 when you issue it. No additional PO text required beyond the number.

I attached a signed onboarding form and updated invoice that lists the GL code for the onboarding fee. Please issue when ready.

Best,
Elena

Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form_SaaSify_signed.pdf, Draft_Invoice_SaaSify_v2.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@saasify.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO issuance & spend cap / line-item splits for SaaSify onboarding

Elena —

PO_78932 has been generated and is attached. Notes: 

- PO_78932 covers Q3 (Jul–Sep) with a total provisional cap of $75,000 and an Overage monthly cap of $25,000. Line items: Subscription (USD 37,500), Overage (provisional cap USD 25,000), Premium Support (USD 9,000), Onboarding fee (USD 6,500).
- Please include PO_78932 on all invoices and send invoices to ap@saasify.io.
- If you need separate PO numbers for calendar regions later, email procurement and we’ll open a follow-up PO.

Forwarding the signed PO now — let me know if any line-item descriptions need adjusting.

Thanks,
Monica
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_PO_78932.pdf (signed)
